meta.title: US Address Generator - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Generate random realistic US addresses with names, phone numbers, and map locations. Select any state, copy each field with one click. Tax-free states clearly marked.
steps_us-address-generator_1: Select a state or use random
steps_us-address-generator_1Desc: Choose a specific US state from the dropdown or leave it on Random for geographic variety. Tax-free states (Alaska, Delaware, Montana, New Hampshire, Oregon) are marked with a ★.
steps_us-address-generator_2Desc: Click Generate to create a complete US address package — full name, gender, street address, city, state, ZIP code, and a state-matched phone number with a real area code.
steps_us-address-generator_3Desc: Click any field to copy just that value to your clipboard. Use Copy All for the full formatted address. The toast notification confirms every copy. The map shows the city location via OpenStreetMap.
